module merge_sorted

public function merge(left: List of Integer, right: List of Integer)
  returns List of Integer
  purpose: Merge two sorted lists of Integers into one sorted list without duplicates.
  example: merge(left: [1, 3, 5], right: [2, 4, 6]) is [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
  example: merge(left: [1, 2, 3], right: [2, 3, 4]) is [1, 2, 3, 4]

  let mutable result be []
  let mutable left_index be 0
  let mutable right_index be 0

  repeat until left_index is at least left.length and right_index is at least right.length
    let left_done be left_index is at least left.length
    let right_done be right_index is at least right.length

    if left_done then
      let next_value be right.at(right_index)
      set right_index to right_index + 1
      if result.is_empty or result.last is not next_value then
        set result to result.append(next_value)
      end
    otherwise if right_done then
      let next_value be left.at(left_index)
      set left_index to left_index + 1
      if result.is_empty or result.last is not next_value then
        set result to result.append(next_value)
      end
    otherwise
      let left_value be left.at(left_index)
      let right_value be right.at(right_index)

      if left_value is less than right_value then
        if result.is_empty or result.last is not left_value then
          set result to result.append(left_value)
        end
        set left_index to left_index + 1
      otherwise if right_value is less than left_value then
        if result.is_empty or result.last is not right_value then
          set result to result.append(right_value)
        end
        set right_index to right_index + 1
      otherwise
        if result.is_empty or result.last is not left_value then
          set result to result.append(left_value)
        end
        set left_index to left_index + 1
        set right_index to right_index + 1
      end
    end
  end

  return result
end

test "merge two empty lists"
  check merge(left: [], right: []) is []
end

module merge_lists
  purpose: Merge sorted lists of integers.

public function merge(first: List of Integer, second: List of Integer)
  returns List of Integer
  purpose: Merge two sorted lists into one sorted list without duplicates.
  example: merge(first: [1, 3, 5], second: [2, 4, 6]) is [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
  example: merge(first: [1, 2, 3], second: [2, 3, 4]) is [1, 2, 3, 4]
  example: merge(first: [], second: []) is []

  let mutable result be []
  let mutable first_index be 0
  let mutable second_index be 0

  repeat until first_index is at least first.length and second_index is at least second.length
    if first_index is at least first.length then
      for each item in second
        if second_index is greater than 0 then
          if item is not result.last then
            set result to result.append(item)
          end
        otherwise
          set result to result.append(item)
        end
        set second_index to second_index + 1
      end
      break
    end

    if second_index is at least second.length then
      for each item in first
        if first_index is greater than 0 then
          if item is not result.last then
            set result to result.append(item)
          end
        otherwise
          set result to result.append(item)
        end
        set first_index to first_index + 1
      end
      break
    end

    let first_value be first.at(first_index)
    let second_value be second.at(second_index)

    if first_value is less than second_value then
      if result.is_empty or first_value is not result.last then
        set result to result.append(first_value)
      end
      set first_index to first_index + 1
    otherwise if second_value is less than first_value then
      if result.is_empty or second_value is not result.last then
        set result to result.append(second_value)
      end
      set second_index to second_index + 1
    otherwise
      if result.is_empty or first_value is not result.last then
        set result to result.append(first_value)
      end
      set first_index to first_index + 1
      set second_index to second_index + 1
    end
  end

  return result
end

test "merge two empty lists"
  check merge(first: [], second: []) is []
end

module merge_lists
  purpose: Merge sorted lists of integers.

public function merge(first: List of Integer, second: List of Integer)
  returns List of Integer
  purpose: Merge two sorted lists into one sorted list without duplicates.
  example: merge(first: [1, 3, 5], second: [2, 4, 6]) is [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
  example: merge(first: [1, 2, 3], second: [2, 3, 4]) is [1, 2, 3, 4]
  example: merge(first: [], second: []) is []

  let mutable result be []
  let mutable first_index be 0
  let mutable second_index be 0
  let first_length be first.length
  let second_length be second.length

  repeat until first_index is at least first_length and second_index is at least second_length
    if first_index is at least first_length then
      let remaining be second.drop(second_index)
      set result to result.append_all(remaining)
      break
    end
    if second_index is at least second_length then
      let remaining be first.drop(first_index)
      set result to result.append_all(remaining)
      break
    end

    let first_value be first.at(first_index)
    let second_value be second.at(second_index)

    if first_value is less than second_value then
      set result to result.append(first_value)
      set first_index to first_index + 1
    otherwise if first_value is greater than second_value then
      set result to result.append(second_value)
      set second_index to second_index + 1
    otherwise
      set result to result.append(first_value)
      set first_index to first_index + 1
      set second_index to second_index + 1
    end
  end

  return result
end

test "merge two empty lists"
  check merge(first: [], second: []) is []
end
